last_amend_reason: ESC-007, authorized by the owner 2026-09-04 ('for esc-007, Use your best judgment. Give my authorization.'). Adds ONE criterion to test_t3_extractor.py: every Hub.evidence_fact_id must resolve to a fact whose source document names the hub's label. Re-measured with a sound rig before spending the authorization — the frozen runner derives REPO_ROOT from its own __file__ and overwrites PYTHONPATH, so it always measures the tree containing the run.py invoked; a verifier copied the whole tree including .swarm-loop/acceptance and ran the copy's own run.py, proving the loaded module's realpath and sabotage marker from inside pytest_configure, with a positive control moving the gate to 98.35/t3=8 in the same run. Under that rig the full pre-repair extract.py shape (CandidateHub.doc_id trusted uncorroborated, a whole document's facts bulk-attached as a hub's evidence) left the gate at exactly 100.0/t3=10/t6=12. Not an unreached branch: instrumentation shows the graded run enters that fallback 107 times and the sabotaged computation would yield different Hub.evidence_fact_ids in 52 of them. Targets moved with it: acceptance_collected 122->123, criteria_t3 10->11.
